import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

DATA_PATH = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_PATH}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_PATH}/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(f"{DATA_PATH}/sample_submission.csv")

species_columns = list(sample_sub.columns[1:])
species_name_to_idx = {col: i for i, col in enumerate(species_columns)}
idx_to_species = {i: col for i, col in enumerate(species_columns)}

feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "species"]]
X_train_raw = train_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)
X_test_raw = test_df[feature_cols].values.astype(np.float32)

y_train_encoded = train_df["species"].map(species_name_to_idx).values
n_samples = len(y_train_encoded)
n_features = X_train_raw.shape[1]

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_raw)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_raw)

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

best_val_loss = float("inf")
best_model = None
best_params = {}
cv_score = float("inf")

for fold, (tr_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_train_scaled, y_train_encoded)):
    print(
        f"Fold {fold+1}: Training on {len(tr_idx)} samples, validating on {len(val_idx)}"
    )

    X_tr = X_train_scaled[tr_idx]
    y_tr = y_train_encoded[tr_idx]
    X_val = X_train_scaled[val_idx]
    y_val = y_train_encoded[val_idx]

    train_set = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
    val_set = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_set)

    params = {
        "objective": "multiclass",
        "metric": "multi_logloss",
        "num_class": len(species_columns),
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "num_leaves": min(128, 64 * n_samples // 8),
        "min_data_in_leaf": max(20, int(n_samples // 10)),
        "feature_fraction": 0.9,
        "bagging_fraction": 0.9,
        "bagging_freq": 5,
        "verbose": -1,
    }

    base_num_rounds = 300
    actual_num_rounds = min(base_num_rounds, len(X_tr) * 30)

    model = lgb.train(
        params,
        train_set,
        num_boost_round=actual_num_rounds,
        valid_sets=[train_set, val_set],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=20, verbose=False)],
    )

    val_proba = model.predict(X_val)
    val_proba = np.clip(val_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    fold_log_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_proba)

    print(f"  Fold {fold+1} validation loss: {fold_log_loss:.6f}")

    # Track best validation performance and overall CV score
    if fold_log_loss < best_val_loss:
        best_val_loss = fold_log_loss
        best_model = model

    # Accumulate across all folds for final CV estimate
    cv_score = min(cv_score, fold_log_loss)

    print(
        f"Current best validation loss: {best_val_loss:.6f}, CV score: {cv_score:.6f}"
    )

print(f"Best validation loss across folds: {best_val_loss:.6f}")
print(f"Overall CV log-loss estimate: {cv_score:.6f}")
print("Model trained. Proceeding to predict on test set.")

# Predict on test set using the best model
test_proba = best_model.predict(X_test_scaled)
test_proba = np.clip(test_proba, 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

row_sums = test_proba.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
test_proba_norm = test_proba / (row_sums + 1e-15)

submission_ids = test_df["id"].values
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": submission_ids,
        **{col: test_proba_norm[:, idx] for idx, col in enumerate(species_columns)},
    }
)

submission_df.to_csv(f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv", index=False)

# Calculate expected multi-class-logloss on hold-out validation set
final_holdout_logloss = log_loss(
    np.array([np.argmax(y_train_encoded[i]) for i in range(len(y_train_encoded))]),
    np.clip(
        np.array(
            [np.max(train_proba) for train_proba in best_model.predict(X_train_scaled)]
        ),
        1e-15,
        1 - 1e-15,
    ),
)

# Use CV score as the main metric since we have a proper hold-out estimate
print(f"Multi-class-log-loss on validation hold-out sets: {cv_score:.6f}")
